summary: Gap-filling for the Caribbean citizenship programmes, Gulf and Americas residence schemes. The main gains are official revenue series from budget estimates: Dominica (12 volumes, CBI revenue FY2011/12-FY2025/26), St Kitts federal estimates 2010-2017 (CBI revenue back to 2008), Saint Lucia estimates 2016/17-2024/25 (CIP fee, surplus and NEF lines) and Grenada CBI-fee lines 2016-2022. Legal texts added: Brazil RN 13/2017 and RN 36/2018 from the Diário Oficial, Mexico's 2012 migration procedure guidelines (first Mexican programme row), and St Kitts S.R.O. 1 of 2026 (new application fees); Brazil business-investor authorisation counts 2011-2022 from OBMigra. Saudi, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman and Paraguay official texts and counts remain out of reach (sites blocked, unreachable or not indexed).
